paragraphs: Welcome to the source code for my personal portfolio website! Here, you’ll find my latest work in web development, IT support, and graphic design. This project not only showcases my skills and experience, but it’s also a playground where I experiment with modern web technologies and UI/UX principles.
I'm Jacob Binala, passionate about crafting digital experiences—from websites to design and IT support solutions. Connect with me on LinkedIn or check out my full design portfolio here.
Inspired by simplicity, accessibility, and the beauty of functional design.
features: Modern Stack: Built with Next.js, Typescript, Tailwind CSS, and React.
Responsive & Accessible: Mobile-friendly design, semantic HTML, and basic accessibility practices.
Dynamic Projects Gallery: Showcases select projects with interactive image carousels.
Skills, Experience & Education: Clearly organized sections for easy browsing.
Dark Mode: Supports dark/light themes for reading comfort.
